pm-ryan: short follow-up from the postmortem  we need a small bridge team to own streaming/chat reconnects, partial responses, and timeout mitigations until we see 14 clean days. owners + quick wins please.

Sanjay: i'll take the reconnect lib and client backoff. will implement exp backoff + jitter and ensure KV resume token handling.

Maria: i'll add a partial_chunk_detected metric and a Prom rule. suggest paging at >4/min sustained for 2m.

Ken: i'll consolidate a one-page runbook, include rollback commands and a canary checklist.

pm-ryan: tasks: RED-8101 SANJAY reconnect lib + tests (ETA Tue); RED-8102 MARIA metric+alert (ETA Thu); RED-8103 KEN runbook+canary (ETA Mon).

Sanjay: quick config proposal: backoff_ms = [200,500,1000,2000], jitter=true, max_retries=4. will avoid double-billing.

Maria: dashboards: partial rate by region + instance heatmap. will add.

Ken: ops-bot, please create a recurring 2-week bridge cadence.

ops-bot: recurring event created: "Streaming Stability Bridge" Mon/Wed 30m starting 2026-03-30. invites sent.

pm-ryan: please update ticket acceptance criteria + tests today. we'll roll up next Tue. if any spike, escalate to P0 and run the playbook.

Sanjay: ack, posting PR in ~3h.

Maria: ack. ping for dashboard pairing.

Ken: ack, will publish runbook and link here.

pm-ryan: thanks all. this thread is canonical for owners and short-term actions.
